items.prep: cut into eighths, or 8 bone-in skin-on chicken legs and thighs

instructions: Preheat oven to 350°F. In a shallow bowl, combine egg and mayonnaise; mix well. In a second bowl, thoroughly combine ingredients for crispy coating.
Spread oil into a 9 x 13-inch baking pan; set aside.
Dip chicken parts into egg mixture and then roll in crispy coating, coating well. Place in the oiled pan.
Spray chicken with cooking spray. Bake, uncovered, for 75-90 minutes.
notes: Crispy, flavorful and so versatile — a great weeknight dinner. Works nicely on both bone-in meat and boneless chicken breast. Per Yidi: a full chicken isn't required — the equivalent quantity of chicken legs/thighs works (the recipe already lists this as an option).

tips.text: You can also use this recipe to prepare skinless, boneless chicken breasts. Bake at 425°F for about 18-20 minutes. Baking time may vary depending on the size and thickness of the pieces.
tips.title: Chicken breasts option
